request.query: WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo,CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi) SELECT indexCode,componentCode,CASE WHEN CAST(startDate AS DATE)<lo THEN CAST(lo AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE startDate END AS bounded_start,CASE WHEN endDate IS NULL OR CAST(endDate AS DATE)>hi THEN CAST(hi AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE endDate END AS bounded_end,startDate IS NOT NULL AS start_known,endDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(endDate AS DATE)<=hi AS ended_in_window FROM lake.index_constituents,bounds WHERE indexCode='GSPC' AND startDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(startDate AS DATE)<=hi AND (endDate IS NULL OR CAST(endDate AS DATE)>=lo) ORDER BY componentCode,bounded_start
SELECT ticker,date,closingPrice,unadjustedClose,volume FROM lake.sec_daily_ohlc WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(? AS DATE) ORDER BY ticker,date

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo,CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM availableAt) AS year,COUNT(*) AS rows,COUNT(DISTINCT eventId) AS events,COUNT(DISTINCT ownerCik) AS owners,COUNT(DISTINCT resolvedTicker) AS tickers,SUM(CASE WHEN ownerCik IS NULL OR eventId IS NULL OR resolvedTicker IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_identity FROM lake.insider_owner_events,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND transactionCode='P' AND acquiredDisposed='A' AND rowKind='nonderiv' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo,CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi) SELECT eventId,ownerCik,issuerCik,resolvedTicker,sourceAccession,versionAccession,rowKind,rowSk,firstAvailableAt,availableAt,CASE WHEN CAST(supersededAt AS DATE)<=hi THEN supersededAt ELSE NULL END AS supersededAt,CASE WHEN CAST(coverageUnverifiedAt AS DATE)<=hi THEN coverageUnverifiedAt ELSE NULL END AS coverageUnverifiedAt,transactionCode,acquiredDisposed,shares,eligibleShare,isOfficer,isDirector FROM lake.insider_owner_events,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND CAST(firstAvailableAt AS DATE)<=hi AND resolvedTicker IN ('AAPL','MSFT') ORDER BY availableAt,eventId,ownerCik

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) AS lo,CAST(? AS DATE) AS hi) SELECT eventId,ownerCik,issuerCik,resolvedTicker,sourceAccession,versionAccession,rowKind,rowSk,tickerIdentityDate,firstAvailableAt,availableAt,CASE WHEN CAST(supersededAt AS DATE)<=hi THEN supersededAt ELSE NULL END AS supersededAt,CASE WHEN CAST(coverageUnverifiedAt AS DATE)<=hi THEN coverageUnverifiedAt ELSE NULL END AS coverageUnverifiedAt,transactionCode,acquiredDisposed,shares,eligibleShare,isOfficer,isDirector FROM lake.insider_owner_events,bounds WHERE CAST(availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi AND CAST(firstAvailableAt AS DATE)<=hi AND resolvedTicker IN ('AAPL','MSFT') ORDER BY availableAt,eventId,ownerCik

request.query: WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) lo,CAST(? AS DATE) hi) SELECT f.accession,f.formType,f.filingDate,f.availableAt,f.availabilitySource,f.issuerCik,f.ownerCik,f.resolvedTicker,f.dateOfOriginalSubmission,s.security_id,s.cik,s.asset_type,GREATEST(s.from_date,lo) listing_from,LEAST(COALESCE(s.to_date,hi),hi) listing_to FROM lake.insider_filings f LEFT JOIN lake.security_segments s ON f.resolvedTicker=s.ticker AND CAST(f.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN s.from_date AND COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31'),bounds WHERE f.resolvedTicker IN ('AAPL','MSFT') AND CAST(f.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi ORDER BY f.accession,f.ownerCik

SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.submissionType,f.filingDate,f.availableAt,f.isAmendment,f.amendmentType,h.infoTableSk,h.cusip,h.resolvedTicker,h.sharesAmount,h.sharesType,h.putCall,h.value,h.availabilitySource FROM lake.institutional_filings f LEFT JOIN lake.institutional_holdings h ON f.accession=h.accession WHERE f.accession IN ('0000002230-14-000072','0000002230-14-000083','0000909012-14-000238','0000909012-14-000247','0001140361-14-018730','0001140361-15-007202') AND CAST(h.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(f.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2014-01-01' AND DATE '2015-12-31' ORDER BY f.accession,h.infoTableSk

SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.submissionType,f.filingDate,f.availableAt,f.isAmendment,f.amendmentType,h.infoTableSk,h.cusip,h.resolvedTicker,h.sharesAmount,h.sharesType,h.putCall,h.value,h.availabilitySource FROM lake.institutional_filings f LEFT JOIN lake.institutional_holdings h ON f.accession=h.accession WHERE f.accession IN ('0000002230-14-000072','0000002230-14-000083','0000909012-14-000238','0000909012-14-000247','0001140361-14-018730','0001140361-15-007202') AND CAST(f.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(? AS DATE) ORDER BY f.accession,h.infoTableSk

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) lo,CAST(? AS DATE) hi) SELECT 'dividend' kind,ticker,CAST(exDividendDate AS DATE) action_date,cashAmount amount,NULL ratio_from,NULL ratio_to FROM lake.dividends,bounds WHERE ticker='AAPL' AND CAST(exDividendDate AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi UNION ALL SELECT 'split',ticker,CAST(executionDate AS DATE),NULL,splitFrom,splitTo FROM lake.stock_splits,bounds WHERE ticker='AAPL' AND CAST(executionDate AS DATE) BETWEEN lo AND hi

SELECT ticker,date,openingPrice,closingPrice,unadjustedClose,volume,priceSource,priceSourceCheckedAt FROM lake.sec_daily_ohlc WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(? AS DATE) AND ((ticker='AAPL' AND CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-08-03' AND DATE '2020-09-03') OR (ticker='MSFT' AND CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2016-01-06' AND DATE '2016-01-13') OR (ticker IN ('NU','ES') AND CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2015-02-12' AND DATE '2015-02-25')) ORDER BY ticker,date

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) lo,CAST(? AS DATE) hi) SELECT ticker,security_id,cik,asset_type,GREATEST(from_date,lo) listing_from,LEAST(COALESCE(to_date,hi),hi) listing_to FROM lake.security_segments,bounds WHERE ticker IN ('NU','ES') AND from_date<=hi AND COALESCE(to_date,hi)>=lo ORDER BY ticker,listing_from

WITH bounds AS (SELECT CAST(? AS DATE) lo,CAST(? AS DATE) hi) SELECT i.componentCode ticker,GREATEST(CAST(i.startDate AS DATE),lo) member_from,LEAST(COALESCE(CAST(i.endDate AS DATE),hi),hi) member_to,s.security_id,s.cik,s.asset_type,GREATEST(s.from_date,lo) listing_from,LEAST(COALESCE(s.to_date,hi),hi) listing_to FROM lake.index_constituents i LEFT JOIN lake.security_segments s ON i.componentCode=s.ticker AND s.from_date<=COALESCE(CAST(i.endDate AS DATE),DATE '2020-12-31') AND COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31')>=CAST(i.startDate AS DATE),bounds WHERE i.indexCode='GSPC' AND CAST(i.startDate AS DATE)<=hi AND COALESCE(CAST(i.endDate AS DATE),hi)>=lo AND (s.from_date IS NULL OR s.from_date<=hi) ORDER BY ticker,member_from,listing_from
